sentences.text: Stinging nettle is pollinated by wind.
The peacock and the small tortoiseshell have been recorded eating stinging nettle, with 3 and 2 GloBI records respectively.
It is also recorded as a host plant for the peacock (3 GloBI records), the map (2 GloBI records), and the small tortoiseshell (2 GloBI records).
In Mainz-Bingen, most reports fall between April and July.
